notes.manas-2010:p1263:b001:l008: Мыйзамдын гүлү is early-autumn airborne gossamer, not a flower of the law: Yudakhin мыйзам II.2 gives this exact expression. https://el-sozduk.kg/мыйзам/
notes.manas-2010:p1263:b001:l012: Seven days is retained beside the spring-to-autumn signs and the six-month battle at l039; the witness chronology is not harmonized.
notes.manas-2010:p1263:b001:l015: Жылас expresses complete destruction. Retained despite the subsequent continuing army; no numerical or narrative repair.
notes.manas-2010:p1263:b001:l016: Кургуштап provisionally rendered driving together from the massing-army context; exact force and the subject relation across l016–018 remain uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p1264:b002:l012: Printed огой provisionally read as Ногой in the paired Kyrgyz/Nogoy peoples formula; the apparent dropped initial н is not repaired in raw source.
notes.manas-2010:p1264:b002:l017: Сойлоп literally creeping is retained though incongruous with the preceding wild-ass chase; no silent emendation to playing or roaming.
notes.manas-2010:p1264:b002:l024: Жая is horse-rump meat; the anatomical food term is retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1264:b002:l026: Жаң-жуң is a governor-general title here; unlike the established personal name Ay Jangjung, it is glossed.
notes.manas-2010:p1265:b001:l006: Forty khans retained; p1263:l014 and p1272:l022 say twenty. No harmonization.
notes.manas-2010:p1265:b001:l018: Жалгыз көз is the epic One-Eyed people, explicitly nonhuman in appearance; no substitution of a historical ethnic group.
notes.manas-2010:p1265:b001:l026: Магшар is the eschatological gathering/resurrection; the black-donkey punishment in the next lines is retained literally.
notes.manas-2010:p1265:b001:l040: Түгөнгөн жан understood as finite, expended mortal life in the offer of self-sacrifice; syntax compressed.
notes.manas-2010:p1266:b001:l020: Даңгыт here is a mature male dog, not an ethnonym: Yudakhin даңгыт gives mature male dog/wolf and the 1969 dictionary cites the exact road-disposal formula. https://el-sozduk.kg/даңгыт/
notes.manas-2010:p1266:b001:l023: Бейжай is the quarrelsome/unrestrained person in the local glossary p1835:l023–024. The accusative figure is retained as that unruly one; antecedent is uncertain, not silently made the speakers.
notes.manas-2010:p1266:b001:l024: Чалыяр understood as the Four Companions/early caliphs; Beijing untouched by them is an epic religious claim, not a historical assertion by the translator.
notes.manas-2010:p1266:b001:l026: Алакең is the affectionate Alake form of Almambet; retained as the name form.
notes.manas-2010:p1267:b001:l007: Akkelte firearm, Akkula horse and Akolpok armor are three distinct named possessions absent here; retained despite later substitute gun and coat.
notes.manas-2010:p1267:b001:l010: Chubak is expressly named as having hurried the departure without fetching the equipment. The following hero-description shifts back toward Manas by l031; no silent name repair.
notes.manas-2010:p1267:b001:l023: Он эки кылым салбаган provisionally takes кылым temporally as twelve ages and leaves the elliptical action unexpanded. Yudakhin also gives world/all peoples in epic use; the intended comparison is uncertain. https://el-sozduk.kg/кылым/
notes.manas-2010:p1267:b001:l035: The source compares Talas and Keng-Kol, then Chubak and Manas; both comparisons retained despite Keng-Kol being within the Talas setting.
notes.manas-2010:p1267:b001:l039: Арбак is guardian/spirit power here. Chubak is said inferior only in that respect; no claim of equal supernatural protection introduced.
notes.manas-2010:p1267:b001:l042: Ырапыс is rep/ribbed fabric, not a personal name: Yudakhin репс; 1969 dictionary cites this Chubak line. https://el-sozduk.kg/ырапыс/
notes.manas-2010:p1268:b001:l003: Тобокел is the spoken entrusting of oneself to God while taking the risk, rendered in English rather than transliterated as a complete utterance.
notes.manas-2010:p1268:b001:l007: Алмам is the shortened possessive/affectionate Alma form; акыреттик describes companionship extending to the afterlife.
notes.manas-2010:p1268:b001:l021: Жойкума is a keen heroic sword here, not a mace or ramrod: Yudakhin жойкума. The dictionary also gives ramrod in firearm-cleaning contexts. https://el-sozduk.kg/жой/
notes.manas-2010:p1268:b001:l042: Машаа/маша is a gun hammer; Yudakhin explicitly cites the curved horse-neck comparison. Literal image retained, rather than generic hinge. https://el-sozduk.kg/маша/
notes.manas-2010:p1269:b001:l008: Даңкан is the clod kicked out by a hoof; Yudakhin gives the exact cauldron-sized formula. https://el-sozduk.kg/даңкан/
notes.manas-2010:p1269:b001:l029: Үч explicitly gives three occasions of bringing Algara within reach; not replaced with quickness or an invented distance.
notes.manas-2010:p1269:b001:l033: Кынайым provisionally press close in spear fighting; the horse is the continuing speaker.
notes.manas-2010:p1269:b001:l039: Printed суу жутуп, чөп жебей says drinking water and not eating grass; the negation is not extended to water.
notes.manas-2010:p1270:b001:l003: Ажыкем is Azhybay addressed affectionately. Manas declines both the borrowed coat and Kartküröng; no explanation of that refusal is supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p1270:b001:l020: The horse curses Manas with one death versus a thousand; the source anthropomorphism and repetition are retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1270:b001:l028: Сыргак is explicitly named though already among the two being rescued; retained without silently replacing him with Almambet or Manas.
notes.manas-2010:p1271:b001:l011: Кечилдин каны is khan of the monks; religious designation and khan title are retained together.
notes.manas-2010:p1271:b001:l033: Ысылам is Islam as the four champions' battle cry, rendered using the established English name.
notes.manas-2010:p1272:b001:l012: Printed ажыран provisionally understood as ажырап, deprived/separated, with the preceding eye injuries and following mutilated limbs. Raw reading retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1272:b001:l025: l024–027 compress Kongurbay's retreat, many Chinese, and an enemy nearing capture of Outer Beijing. English leaves the final he without adding a silently named subject; source subject transition remains uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p1272:b001:l034: Бөйкү in the named divination expression remains unverified: төлгө is divination, but neither a primary lexical sense nor secure named-object identification for бөйкү was established. Whole verse preserved outside English count; no invented oracle method. Completion-first first pass: Low-confidence approximate rendering for “Бөйкү деген төлгөсүн”; nearest corpus parallel was “Сынайлык деген сынчы өлгөн,”.
notes.manas-2010:p1273:b001:l001: Качкын is taken as Almambet's renegade epithet in the clause continuing the preceding slaughter forecast, not as a new action of becoming a renegade.
notes.manas-2010:p1273:b001:l005: Доорук is event/experience, confirmed by Yudakhin and the 2015 dictionary exact formula. https://el-sozduk.kg/Доо/
notes.manas-2010:p1273:b001:l014: Даңза is written register; the prophecy is said to be inscribed, not newly written on seeing the battle.
notes.manas-2010:p1273:b001:l024: Бичик is a written document/scroll here, not an invented personal name or an English source quotation.
notes.manas-2010:p1274:b001:l003: Кылым interpreted with Yudakhin epic world/all sense as fill the world. The two-hide muster gives a vast completed host, but no verified exact troop-unit value is invented. https://el-sozduk.kg/кылым/
notes.manas-2010:p1274:b001:l011: The PDF reads чубап, filing in a stream; refers to the soldiers filing out. The actual destruction of hides occurs at l031–033.
notes.manas-2010:p1274:b001:l026: The source switches from a dimmed sun to river/lake imagery; the unusual mixed comparison is retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1274:b001:l028: Азирети Аалы is Hazrat Ali. His retreat is the epic speaker's claim, not independently verified history.
notes.manas-2010:p1274:b001:l037: Кылым again rendered world in the fulfilled muster formula; no invented numerical equivalence.
notes.manas-2010:p1274:b001:l042: Ташын, his stone(s), retained in the destruction command; no silent emendation to башын, his head.
notes.manas-2010:p1275:b001:l023: Жолой uses the established Zholoy spelling; Ылама is the named khan Ylama here, not automatically a generic lama.
notes.manas-2010:p1275:b001:l040: Forty guardian lions retained alongside the single black-spotted leopard; not reduced to a generalized protective animal.
notes.manas-2010:p1276:b001:l010: Forty days is a travel span across the desert, not a converted mileage or battle duration.
notes.manas-2010:p1276:b001:l018: The swan's ears burning are expressly printed; the anatomically unusual epic heat image is retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1276:b001:l035: Шай provisionally holy protecting power in the established saintly-protector context; exact saint/rank referent not named by the line.
notes.manas-2010:p1276:b001:l041: Көк describes fierce unyielding temperament, not a literal color of Manas; contextual sense follows the primary көк entry.
notes.manas-2010:p1277:b001:l001: The herding-pole destruction formula recurs, now within Kongurbay's description of Manas; retained despite compressed relation to the mountain image.
notes.manas-2010:p1277:b001:l007: Колу сынса: arm breaking is retained literally, five times; alternative army being broken is possible for кол, but no extra army or five replacement armies is invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1277:b001:l011: Азганакай taken as a little, qualifying the simple-mindedness across l011–012, not wandering or a proper name. Yudakhin азгана/азганакай gives a little: https://tamgasoft.kg/dict/index.php?alf1=а&alf2=аз&cur_page=2&dic_id=2&page=list_words
notes.manas-2010:p1277:b001:l018: Боз качыр explicitly calls Aybanboz a gray mule; not harmonized to horse, though ат also occurs.
notes.manas-2010:p1277:b001:l025: Шуркут equals шуркуя, wanton woman (Yudakhin; also bold/wayward woman); казыналык indicates treasury/state keeping. Captive-breeding context supports the sexual sense, not monks. https://el-sozduk.kg/шуркут/ and https://el-sozduk.kg/шуркуя/
notes.manas-2010:p1277:b001:l026: Айгыр сал is using/keeping a stud; here the captive Manas is to sire children on forty women. Sexual coercion and planned royal heir are explicit, not softened to appointing an official. Yudakhin сал VI.6: https://el-sozduk.kg/sal/
notes.manas-2010:p1277:b001:l036: Бел in this reproductive prediction is loins; the extraordinary unborn child is retained without adding a name not present.
notes.manas-2010:p1278:b001:l010: Parenthetical narrator insult doŋuz, swine, retained with parentheses, not discarded as editorial prose.
notes.manas-2010:p1278:b001:l019: Printed эмп read as эми, now, in the repeated formula; raw source unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p1278:b001:l023: Кул used as contemptuous fellow in the duel narrative; does not establish a new historical slave status for Kongurbay.
notes.manas-2010:p1278:b001:l042: Кол for the mount is foreleg(s), not human hands; Aybanboz follows into the place Kongurbay vacates.
notes.manas-2010:p1279:b001:l006: Ыйык жал literally sacred mane retained; no anatomical substitution or new named object.
notes.manas-2010:p1279:b001:l011: Six days without water is retained alongside the earlier prospective six-day spear fight; chronology is not repaired.
notes.manas-2010:p1279:b001:l020: Rhetorical God-strike expression says Kongurbay will not foolishly stand by; retained as a question, without inventing a literal divine blow here.
notes.manas-2010:p1279:b001:l025: Printed мөндүлөп provisionally understood with мөндүр, hail, for the repeated battle-cry image; raw consonant form preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p1279:b001:l038: Ач болот is the established named sword Achbolot, not generic steel in this equipped-weapon context.
notes.manas-2010:p1280:b001:l003: Жаза чаап is a missed slash at Algara's thigh; no successful wounding is introduced.
notes.manas-2010:p1280:b001:l016: Аманат life is entrusted/held in trust; the religious figure is retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1280:b001:l038: Он эки курчап is interpreted as twelve encircling ranks; twelve retained, with no invented total army size.
notes.manas-2010:p1281:b001:l009: Ыйман бер retained as prayer for faith in mortal danger; not silently changed into surrender or a request that the enemy convert.
notes.manas-2010:p1281:b001:l011: Боз келте rendered the short gray gun here, explicitly not the absent Akkelte; the witness's different weapons remain distinct.
notes.manas-2010:p1281:b001:l019: The source contrasts booming first shot with later weak sputters and short-falling bullets; no mechanism, ammunition failure or magical cause is added.
notes.manas-2010:p1281:b001:l036: Акылай is Akylay, the named maker of this coat; not silently harmonized to Kanykey or the absent Akolpok.
notes.manas-2010:p1282:b001:l013: Эки көзү төрт болду, literally his two eyes became four, rendered as desperate watchful longing.
notes.manas-2010:p1282:b001:l018: Манас эмес introduces that Chubak cannot even save himself, much less Manas; the latter clause is not an instruction to rename the hero.
notes.manas-2010:p1282:b001:l030: Кызыталак retained as an obscene daughter-directed curse, not sanitized; applied to the gray mule, not a literal sexual event.
notes.manas-2010:p1282:b001:l039: Twelve encircling ranks repeated exactly as p1280:l038; no deduplication.
